## Key Services
- [Normal Delivery Care](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/normal-delivery-in-kalyani-nagar/): Personalized prenatal birth prep, active labor monitoring, pelvic floor conditioning.
- [High-Risk Pregnancy Management](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/high-risk-pregnancy-management-in-kalyani-nagar/): Gestational diabetes, PIH preeclampsia, twin pregnancies, recurrent loss.
- [PCOD & PCOS Care](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/pcod-pcos-care-in-kalyani-nagar/): Evidence-based hormonal rebalancing, insulin resistance management, ovulation recovery.
- [Infertility & IUI Care](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/infertility-iui-ivf-in-kalyani-nagar/): Follicular tracking, semen analysis, Intrauterine Insemination (IUI), IVF advisory.
- [Laparoscopic Keyhole Surgery](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/laparoscopic-procedures-in-kalyani-nagar/): Ovarian cystectomy, fibroid myomectomy, endometriosis excision.
- [Scarless Hysterectomy (NDVH)](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/scarless-hysterectomy-in-kalyani-nagar/): Non-descent vaginal hysterectomy with no external abdominal incisions.
- [Cervical Cancer Screening & HPV Vaccine](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/cervical-cancer-vaccination-screening-in-kalyani-nagar/): Painless liquid-based cytology Pap smear, high-risk HPV DNA testing, Gardasil 9 vaccination.
- [Pre-Conceptional Counselling](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/pre-conceptional-counselling-in-kalyani-nagar/): Pre-pregnancy health optimization, genetic screening, prenatal nutrition.
- [Hysteroscopy Procedures](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/hysteroscopy-in-kalyani-nagar/): HD endoscopic evaluation of uterine cavity, polyp removal, septum resection.
- [Menstrual Cycle Disorders](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/menstrual-cycle-problems-in-kalyani-nagar/): Heavy bleeding (menorrhagia), dysmenorrhea, irregular periods.
- [Family Planning & Contraception](https://drdeepikalalwani.com/contraception-advice-in-kalyani-nagar/): Copper-T / Mirena IUD insertion, oral pills, injectable contraception.

## Patient Service Areas
Kalyani Nagar, New Kalyani Nagar, Wadgaon Sheri, Koregaon Park, Viman Nagar, Chandan Nagar, Ramwadi, Yerawada, Magarpatta, Kharadi, Pune.
